liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Dripping Tap** (1 review): Starts with a blistering Dripping Tap and never lets up [11]

## Setlist highlights

- **kglw2023.06.01.matrix.dankski.t01**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [12]
- **kglw2023.06.01.matrix.dankski.t02**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [12]
- **kglw2023.06.01.matrix.dankski.t03**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [12]
- **kglw2023.06.01.matrix.dankski.t04**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [12]
- **kglw2023.06.01.matrix.dankski.t05**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [12]
- **kglw2023.06.01.matrix.dankski.t06**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [12]
- **kglw2023.06.01.matrix.dankski.t07**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [12]
- **kglw2023.06.01.matrix.dankski.t08**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [12]

## The recordings

- **kglw2023-06-01.danktrix** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 18 songs; 113 min [1]
- **kglw2023-06-01**: source not stated; 18 songs; 113 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Unlike typical fuzzy Caverns tapes, this recording sounds fantastic [8]
- **kglw2023-06-01.sbd-flac**: soundboard; 17 songs; 114 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [5]. Said about its sound: Question raised about whether the soundboard is truly lossless or stream-derived [10]
- **kglw2023-06-01.dr40**: source not stated; 16 songs; 113 min [6]
- **kglw2023-06-01.FLAC.bootleggermix**: soundboard; 0 songs; 114 min [7]

## Around the show

- Right channel drop out required patching both left and right channels [2]
- Mixed by Stu Mackenzie and Sam Joseph for the bootlegger mix [7]

## Tapers and lineage

- **kglw2023-06-01.danktrix**: taped by DankskiVision; transferred by TeddyDunski; source: Zoom Matrix [1]
- **kglw2023-06-01**: taped by Twenty8; transferred by Twenty8; source: Audio Technica AT853 hypercardioid > SoundPro battery box > Sony A10 [2]
- **kglw2023-06-01.sbd-flac**: source: SBD [5]
- **kglw2023-06-01.dr40**: taped by Evander [6]. Also: Recorded on ground in front of soundboard, processed in Logic Pro X; Individual channels normalized to -23 LUFS before conversion to FLAC [6]
- **kglw2023-06-01.FLAC.bootleggermix**: taped by Sam Joseph, Nico Wilson, Gaspard Demulemeester and Joseph Santarpia; source: SBD [7]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by panetory.com: [King Gizzard And The Lizard Wizard Pelham June 1 2023 Raid The Caverns Poster 2026](https://panetory.com/king-gizzard-and-the-lizard-wizard-pelham-june-1-2023-raid-the-caverns-poster) [13]
